text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Back-to-back Champions Cup wins...
There's a reason no one's ever done it."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
A race targeted by many top contenders every year.
Therefore, a guaranteed victory is impossible. To win consecutively...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of Umamusume comes at me, or with what strategy,
I need the strength to defeat them all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—just before the main event.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... *cough*... Literally dying here...
But...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: We gave it everything we had, didn't we, Trainy...
choice_data_list: Yeah, you held out really well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Based on the data gathered by Cinemagun,
I calculated the optimal training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was harsh beyond imagination, but...
for a whole month, I was able to push myself fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All that's left... is to see the result.
I have no regrets left. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Our opponents are stronger than ever before.
Espo-n, Furio, Accu-san,
everyone's coming out..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The problem is――whether the toll from all that agonizing
will linger and hurt us.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
While I was feeling down, everyone else was working hard.
Whether I can close that gap or not...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hope is endless.
And at the same time—anxiety is endless, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stronger the thirst for victory,
the greater the fear of defeat becomes.
I must do something about this anxiety...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hm, a LANE message? From who...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's a message of support...
choice_data_list: Is it from the girls from the north?
Is it from the girls from the north?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: No, the one who sent me off was...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Way out west...
The girls from Kyushu.

text_block_list.name: Kyushu Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... "Tran-chan,
good luck with your race!"... and send.

text_block_list.name: Kyushu Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Put a smile on the face of the person who matters most to you, Tran-chan.
We're rooting for you too!"

text_block_list.name: Kyushu Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, is this okay?

text_block_list.name: Kyushu Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! All of us friends together. It'd be great if we could all get hyped up and have a big laugh!

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, Transcend.
Show everyone hope!" ...And there!

text_block_list.name: Shikoku Fan
text_block_list.text: "Tran-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Seto Inland Sea Fan
text_block_list.text: "Transcend...!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah... ah... aah...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The voices... are gathering...
More and more...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Only words can reach...
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Carrying everyone's wishes...
All of their... feelings...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is... cheering for
what we're trying to do...
choice_data_list: The circle of empathy... has spread

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: A circle... of empathy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's true that this country is vast. Even when a major disaster occurs,
not everyone can easily share the same feelings.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "A circle formed around Transcend, who had traveled all across the country. It was more than just information—it was a 'network of empathy.'"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...
Trainy, I...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. We definitely stumbled a bit. But—”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I've got this network
right here to back me up!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are, Tran-san.
Looking forward to today.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tran! If you don't come at me with everything you've got,
I'm gonna beat you till you cry!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, you've got this
dead-eyed stare going on today, huh."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. I'm completely prepared this time.
And not just with information...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The emotional backup is perfect too!
So I'm taking the win, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san,
this... might be a tough one.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Back-to-back Champions Cup victories.
I've got a reason I have to pull this off!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I won't lose to anyone.
No matter what hardships come my way!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(I'll share it with the world from right here!
A hope that will never run dry no matter what happens—I swear it!)
